question: Can pdf.js coordinate-only reconstruction recover Smart Choice benefit-grid values without plain-text reading order?
sources_searched: Smart Choice 1500 Plan Doc 2025 (1).pdf, 909482 bytes, 81 pages, PDF pages 6-10
note: Documents a Smart Choice-specific method test related to G-016. TESTED 2026-09-10 AND REJECTED. Node with the pdf.js bundled in pdf-parse, getTextContent coordinates and getOperatorList only, no reading-order extraction. Reconstruction was NOT trustworthy as a basis for benefit facts. Evidence: (1) dollar amounts split across overlapping text items, so an x-order join reproduces a plausible amount by reading-order inference, not geometry; (2) wrapped label text crosses the value-column bands and would be read as cost-sharing; (3) the column header naming the value columns itself crosses the derived split; (4) no ruling strokes on pages 6-10 and fill rectangles duplicate and overlap in y, so row detection reduces to 2pt baseline gaps, which is inference; (5) pages 7-10 need different band logic than page 6, so tuned bands do not generalise within one document; (6) rows marked clean only mean no threshold flag fired, not that cell structure was verified. CONCLUSION: plain text extraction and pdf.js coordinate clustering are both DISALLOWED for Smart Choice benefit-grid values. The next viable method is raster or image-based positional reading with human verification, or write nothing. This finding is Smart Choice only - TDK, GHDP and Access Health grids carry ruling strokes and were not tested.
